Animal Handler.Description: You’ve learned to raise, train, and care for animals, particularly partially uplifted smart animals.

Artist/Icon.Description: You are a musician, performer, celebrity, or other type of creative or public figure.

Async.Description: You are infected with the Watts-MacLeod strain of the exsurgent virus, which gives you a number of unique mental talents and disadvantages. You must purchase the Psi trait in Step 10.

Commander.Description: You are accustomed to leadership roles as an executive, officer, elected official, or autonomist organizer.

Fighter.Description: You’ve picked up some self-defense and offensive capabilities along the way.

Forensics Specialist.Description: You’ve trained to analyze crime scenes and perform autopsies.

Jack-of-All-Trades.Description: You’ve seen and done a little bit of everything.

Jammer.Description: You’re a drone operator, with a talent for manipulating machines.

Networker.Description: You know how to engage and connect with people.

Paramedic.Description: You have picked up some first aid training.

Pilot.Description: You prefer to do the driving yourself, no matter how skilled the AI is.

Rogue.Description: You are as shifty as you need to be.

Slacker.Description: You prefer to enjoy the good things in life.

Spacer.Description: You’ve spent your fair share of time in ships and smaller habitats.

Student.Description: You are in the process of learning.

Survivalist.Description: The Fall reinforced the notion that you need to be prepared.
